concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balance-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-balanceaccount-balance-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured Balance webhook contract for a balance account reaching or falling below a configured balance-type threshold; available, settled, pending and reserved fields are distinct, and the alert is not a transaction or payout result.

- [[source-adyen-api-explorer-balance-webhooks-latest-post-balanceplatform-balanceaccount-balance-updated]] — 2026-09-15-captured incoming `balancePlatform.balanceAccount.balance.updated` threshold-event schema with setting IDs, account/currency and optional balance values; `2xx` acknowledges receipt without proving funds movement.
